def deny(*a,**k): raise RuntimeError('offline child forbids network')

 r=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)

frames=[]; final=result=resources=None
for line in out.splitlines():

    packed=json.loads(line)

else: print('NO_FINAL_MEASUREMENT',execution['exit_code'],'partial_frames',len(frames),flush=True)
